reviewed_by: Codex peer messaging focused coverage review
reason: Default resolution, legacy upgrade preservation, provider and harness tool awareness, opt-out, peer boundaries, durable delivery, retry idempotency, and cloud consent are exercised by the selected Core files. Component tests cover defaults, explicit false, and consent recovery. One committed two-conversation real-Core journey covers creation, visible messages, next-turn reply, off, refresh, and reconnect in the production bundle on a LAN origin across permanent desktop and mobile Chromium and WebKit profiles.
exclusions: No Rust or native code changed. Unrelated Python, frontend, and browser journeys and full suites are excluded. Physical device testing is not automated by this selection and must be reported separately.
